title: Maximum eddy-viscosity ratio
overview: Caps the modeled eddy viscosity relative to the local laminar viscosity through the shared TurbCappedEddyViscosity policy. The cap is used by the audited SA and SST eddy-viscosity calculations.
principle: The source policy returns mu_t = min(mu_t_uncapped, max_vis_ratio * mu_l). The ratio is dimensionless when both viscosities use the same convention. This is a numerical upper bound, not a turbulence-model closure formula.
architecture: TurbCom::Init reads max_vis_ratio. TurbSrcFlux passes it into both SaComputeEddyViscosity and SstComputeEddyViscosity; each uses TurbCappedEddyViscosity from TurbViscosityPolicy.cpp. The shared policy is also directly unit-tested.

proves: The SA and SST cell-viscosity paths pass max_vis_ratio to the shared viscosity-cap policy.
The shared policy has unit tests for applying the cap and preserving values below the cap.
does_not_prove: A universally recommended value or admissible range for every flow and turbulence model.
That the selected cap is physically appropriate for every mesh, Reynolds number, or turbulence closure.
A stability, convergence, or accuracy guarantee for a complete CFD simulation.

examples.title: Apply the maximum eddy-viscosity ratio cap (matches the pure-policy test)
examples.input: Uncapped eddy viscosity mu_t = 100; laminar viscosity mu_l = 2; max_vis_ratio = 10.
examples.calculation: The cap is mu_t,max = 2 * 10 = 20. The policy returns min(100, 20) = 20.
examples.result: The returned eddy viscosity is 20. If the uncapped value is 5 with the same laminar viscosity and ratio, the policy preserves 5 because it is below the cap.
examples.limitations: This is the shared algebraic policy tested by TurbViscosityPolicy. It does not determine an appropriate max_vis_ratio for a physical case or establish full SA/SST solution accuracy.

formulas.title: Eddy-viscosity ratio cap
formulas.assumptions: Applied after the uncapped SA or SST eddy viscosity has been computed; both viscosity inputs use the same source convention.

symbols.notes: The returned value is stored as the turbulent viscosity field.

symbols.meaning: Configured maximum ratio of modeled to laminar viscosity.
symbols.notes: The cap is dimensionless when both viscosities share units.

caveats: The cap is a numerical policy shared by the audited SA and SST paths; a test of the policy does not establish a recommended case value or end-to-end CFD accuracy.
